_comment: Venues whose own website publishes no readable events because the page is a DICE widget. Read via the venue's PUBLIC DICE PAGE, never api.dice.fm — dice.fm/robots.txt allows '/' and disallows exactly '/api/', and that distinction is the entire basis for this adapter. Events are server-rendered into the page's __NEXT_DATA__, so no API call is needed to see them. See the header of mapsee_ingest_dice_venue.py before adding a source.
_before_you_add_one: Find the venue through DICE's own published sitemap (dice.fm/sitemaps/venues/sitemap.xml, 27 files of 200) rather than guessing a slug — the slug carries a random suffix and a guess 404s. Then confirm the page carries __NEXT_DATA__ with an events list, and that every event has venues[0].location; this adapter does no geocoding and skips anything unplaceable.
_do_not: The venue's own site embeds a DICE widget config with a partnerId and an apiKey in plain sight. Those reach api.dice.fm, which is the one path robots.txt disallows, and they are somebody else's credential. If you need more than the page carries, get a real DICE_API_KEY and use mapsee_ingest_dice.py instead.

venues.name: The Vera Project (Seattle)
venues._note: All-ages, volunteer-run music and arts venue at Seattle Center; 305 Harrison St. Requested via theveraproject.org/events/, whose page is a bare DICE widget container — no event markup, no JSON-LD, and robots.txt Disallow: /*? rules out ?ical=1 and the Tribe REST API alike. Measured 2026-08-10: 30 listings, 2026-08-11 to 2026-09-16, all carrying exact coordinates (47.62186, -122.35404). 'community' as a secondary because Vera is a youth-run nonprofit and its shows are as much community events as gigs.
venues._also_at_this_venue: The widget on theveraproject.org filters on two venue names, 'The Vera Project' and 'The Black Lodge'. Only the first is configured here; The Black Lodge is a separate DICE venue page and worth adding on its own terms rather than smuggling it in through Vera's.

venues.name: The Black Lodge (Seattle)
venues._note: 429 Eastlake Ave E; DIY all-ages music space. The second venue in theveraproject.org's widget filter, added here on its OWN page rather than through Vera's — the two share a promoter, not a location, and folding them together would have put Black Lodge shows at Vera's coordinates. Measured 2026-08-10: 13 listings, 2026-08-10 to 2026-11-07, all on-sale and all carrying coordinates (47.62295, -122.329458).
venues._not_bandsintown: bandsintown.com/v/10061338-the-black-lodge lists the same shows and is NOT usable: mapsee_ingest.py's fetch_bandsintown_events stub records that their §3g bars aggregation without a partner deal, and the page answers 403 to the production User-Agent regardless. DICE is where these events are sold, so it is the better source anyway.
